characters.name: 苏青
characters.design: 35-year-old female air traffic controller, wearing neat dark blue uniform shirt, hair tied up neatly, over-ear headset covering ears, focused expression, sharp professional aura, medium shot, cool ambient light from radar screens illuminating her face, realistic skin texture, consistent with 35-year-old East Asian female appearance.

characters.name: 周远航
characters.design: 51-year-old male pilot, white pilot uniform with four rank stripes on sleeves, short black hair with graying temples, sharp jawline, upright sitting posture, medium shot, soft cockpit ambient light, natural skin tone, realistic middle-aged East Asian male appearance, professional and calm demeanor.

props.name: 头戴式管制耳机
props.design: Over-ear air traffic control headset, matte black plastic shell, soft padded ear cups, flexible gooseneck microphone, subtle wear marks, placed on controller's head, cool tone, realistic texture, close-up or medium shot detail, matches professional aviation equipment style.

props.name: 雷达显示屏
props.design: Rectangular airport radar display screen, cold blue-green glowing interface with flight position markers, matte black bezel, faint screen glare, placed on control tower console, low-key lighting, realistic electronic device texture, medium shot, consistent with night aviation control environment.

props.name: 塔台通话面板
props.design: Wall-mounted air traffic control communication panel, matte dark gray surface with illuminated function buttons, small display showing flight call sign, wired handset attached, subtle wear marks, placed on control tower console, cool low-key lighting, realistic aviation equipment texture, medium shot detail.

issues: 显示屏显示的文字内容（H 517 9 C6400、WNFC&、@-F8a808）格式混乱，非标准航班呼号，与设计要点要求的'small display showing flight call sign'不符

scenes.name: 塔台夜间管制室
scenes.design: Nighttime air traffic control tower cabin, circular panoramic windows, distant runway light strings visible outside, cold radar screen glow, control panel with communication equipment, half-empty coffee cup on console, low-key cool lighting, deep shadows in unlit corners, realistic documentary style, 16:9 aspect ratio, matches given night aviation scene setting.

scenes.name: 民航机长驾驶舱
scenes.design: Nighttime commercial airliner cockpit, illuminated instrument panel, pilot seat with upright pilot figure, faint cabin ambient light, realistic flight deck details, medium shot, cool desaturated color grade, professional aviation atmosphere, consistent with given cockpit scene description.

scenes.name: 机场夜间跑道
scenes.design: Night airport runway, wet pavement reflecting warm runway lights, faint tire sparks from landing aircraft, distant control tower silhouette, cool dark tone with warm light accents, wide shot, realistic documentary style, matches the landing scene requirement of the advertisement.
